mapper.select:
SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.USER_ID AS userId, O.TOTAL_PRICE AS price,
OI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, OI.COUNT AS count,
( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY PI.SORT_ORDER ASC, PI.IMAGE_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imgUrl,
UA.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, UA.ADDRESS AS address, UA.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress
FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN USER_ADDRESS UA ON O.USER_ID = UA.USER_ID AND UA.ADDRESS_ID = ( SELECT UA2.ADDRESS_ID FROM USER_ADDRESS UA2 WHERE UA2.USER_ID = O.USER_ID ORDER BY UA2.DEFAULT_YN DESC, UA2.ADDRESS_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_EXCHANGE ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, EXCHANGE_REASON, REASON_DETAIL, EXCHANGE_METHOD, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAILED_ADDRESS, MEMO, EXCHANGE_STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{exchangeReason}, #{reasonDetail}, #{exchangeMethod}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailedAddress}, #{memo}, 'REQUESTED', NOW() )
